parties:
Suhel Ahmed Chowdhury ----- Appellant
Vs.
Salahuddin Ayubi and others ----- Respondents
full_judgment: "We have not been able to persuade ourselves to agree with the manner in which the matter has been dealt with, particularly the rude words used against the appellant. A high officer of the Government at the far end of his career with a long service record without any allegation of blemish prior to the present incident should have been dealt with more consideration and objectivity. An honest person would prefer dignity more than anything else. In the facts of the present case it has appeared to us that these considerations have suffered a great deal because of the lack of objectivity and perhaps, over placed sympathy for the respondent who was alleged to have been deprived of the fruit of the court's decree for more than a decade. The court has fallen on the appellant with heavy hands to express its disgust. But the appellant has not had a fair, even-handed and objective treatment at the hands of the High Court Division."
